entries.title: Your brand and your shooter book
entries.body: Set your brand once on the new You page and it marks every video you render. A shooter's colour, club and logo now follow them from match to match.

entries.title: A match summary at the end of the video
entries.body: Turn on Match summary under Look on the Export page: after the last stage, your average split, best draw, hits and a row per stage. On the grid, each shooter gets a tile.

entries.title: Made with splitsmith on the closing card
entries.body: The closing card now ends with a small Made with splitsmith line. Turn it off under Credit in Details on the Export page; your choice is kept with your presets.

entries.title: The event's logo on the title page
entries.body: Add the match's own logo under Branding in Details on the Export page. The title page and closing card show it above the match name.

entries.title: Your brand on the title page
entries.body: Add your club, personal or sponsor logo and a line to a Look under Card styles, Your brand. The title page and closing card show it in the top left corner.

entries.title: Club line from the scoreboard
entries.body: Linking a shooter to their scoreboard entry now fills their club line for the cards, unless you already typed one.

entries.title: Make your own Look
entries.body: Pick Make your own beside the Looks on the Export page, name it and choose what it starts from. Discard removes a new Look you changed your mind about.

entries.title: A clearer Look editor
entries.body: The preview now says when it is updating and shows a still before the animation, colours have plain names, and a demo scene lets you compare Looks without footage.

entries.title: Look previews on synced matches
entries.body: On splitsmith.app, the Look editor and the Export preview now draw the cards of a match synced from the desktop app instead of staying blank.

entries.title: Your own font in a Look
entries.body: Add a TTF or OTF file under Card styles, Fonts in the Look editor and use it for titles or figures, the clock included. Desktop app only.

entries.title: Faster second renders of a compare grid
entries.body: Rendering a compare grid again reuses every stage, card and transition that did not change, as a single shooter's video already did.

entries.title: Club colours on Compare and shared pages
entries.body: A shooter's accent and logo now mark them on Compare, in the shooter chips and on the Splits pages, shared links included.

entries.title: Previews that move
entries.body: An animated card or sting now plays in the Export page's preview and in the Look editor, looping, on your own footage.

entries.title: Broken templates show before you export
entries.body: When your own Look has a template that fails, the Export page says which cards would be left out before you render, with the line that broke.

entries.title: Choose your Look's fonts
entries.body: Pick the title and figure faces under Card styles in the Look editor; the cards, the stage summary and the running clock all draw with them.

entries.title: Long stage names fit the cards
entries.body: A long stage name on the title page, a slate or the lower third shrinks to fit the frame, and ends in an ellipsis when it still does not.

entries.title: Palettes that stand out on your footage
entries.body: The Look editor suggests full palettes from one colour, from your club logo, from ready-made range palettes, or from what stands out on this match's own footage.

entries.title: Write your own card templates
entries.body: In the desktop app, the Look editor's Templates tab edits a card's HTML with a live preview, the data it receives and a check that names the broken line.

entries.title: Make your own Look
entries.body: Duplicate a Look under Look, Advanced on the Export page, pick its colours and card styles, and see it on your own footage before you save.

entries.title: Transitions between stages
entries.body: An MP4 can cross from one stage to the next with a fade, a wipe or a dozen other moves, each with a direction. The compare grid gets them too.

entries.title: Stings in your colours
entries.body: A sting sweeps a band in your Look's colours across the cut between stages, carrying the club logo when there is one. Pick Wipe sting under transitions.

entries.title: Cards that rise into place
entries.body: Choose the Rise style for the title page, the stage slates, the lower third or the closing card, and their lines animate in.

entries.title: Your club colour and logo
entries.body: Give each shooter an accent colour, a club line and a logo on the Footage page. The cards, the sting and the stage summary use them.

entries.title: A better beep finder
entries.body: The first beep suggested for a stage is now the right one far more often, so there is less to confirm by hand.

entries.title: Smoother scrubbing in Audit
entries.body: Audit plays a lighter 720p copy of each trim, so seeking stays quick on long 4K clips.

entries.title: Clips you already imported
entries.body: Adding a clip again, even from another folder, is recognised and skipped, and the import says why it skipped each file.

entries.title: Your division on the title page
entries.body: The title page prints the shooter's division as the scoreboard has it. Turn it off under Details on the Export page.
